system.name: Rodrigues Network (RodriNet) with the Neural Rodrigues Operator
system.one_liner: A learnable generalisation of the classical Rodrigues rotation formula for forward kinematics, used as the building block of a network for robot action learning.

content.variant_note: the classical Rodrigues formula and its learnable counterpart drawn in the same tensor-times-vector grammar side by side, then three application cards
content.argues: Replacing the fixed coefficients and joint angles of the classical Rodrigues formula with trainable weights and abstract joint features gives a neural operator that keeps the kinematic structure and serves several action-learning tasks.
content.subject: The classical formula as fixed coefficients times a joint state on a robot arm, its learnable version as message passing with weights times features, and three applications.

lessons.what_to_learn: To show a learnable generalisation, draw the classical formula and the new operator as mirrored frames with identical layout (tensor stack times vector stack), swap the colour family and replace uniform cells by multicoloured ones, then fan out to application cards.

the Rodrigues Network leverages the kinematic structure of articulated systems to advance a wide range of action-learning tasks

summary: The paper proposes the Neural Rodrigues Operator, a learnable generalisation of the classical Rodrigues rotation formula for forward kinematics, and builds the Rodrigues Network on it for robot action learning. Figure 1 is a teaser in three titled columns. In the Classical Operator frame an articulated robot arm with orange joints and a Rotation arrow sits beside a stack of fixed coefficient grids multiplied by the joint-state vector (1, sin θ, cos θ). The Learnable Operator frame mirrors it: a chain of green nodes with Message passing, and a stack of multicoloured learnable weights times a stack of joint features. Three arrows then fan out to dashed Applications cards with thumbnails: Motion prediction, Imitation learning and Hand pose estimation.
summary_zh: 论文提出神经罗德里格斯算子，把经典罗德里格斯旋转公式变为可学习，并据此构建Rodrigues网络学习机器人动作。图1分三栏：经典算子（机械臂、固定系数乘关节状态）、镜像的可学习算子（消息传递、可学习权重乘关节特征）和三张虚线应用卡片。
